title_ja: 狭い表示でも内容と操作を保つ
requirement_en: For applicable one-dimensional web content, inspect vertically scrolling content at a width equivalent to 320 CSS pixels and horizontally scrolling content at a height equivalent to 256 CSS pixels. Determine the threshold from the actual scrolling axis, not the text's reading direction. Required information and functions must remain available without unintended two-axis scrolling.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Use real viewport-equivalent rendering and operation; record width, direction and actual content availability. Viewport resizing does not prove text zoom or other browser coverage. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Fix the responsible width/layout; never hide required content merely to make the screenshot fit.

exception_policy.bounds: Criterion-specific necessary two-dimensional regions may be inapplicable locally. A project waiver with lost content remains waived and cannot establish WCAG conformance.

title_ja: 文字の拡大を実際の操作と確認する
requirement_en: For applicable text, test an actual supported text-enlargement mechanism through 200 percent, retaining content and function. A smaller authored font must not defeat the required enlargement.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Record the real enlargement mechanism and intermediate/maximum states; viewport width changes alone are not this test. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not counteract enlargement with scaling or forced tiny text; keep authorized content and controls usable.

exception_policy.bounds: Assess the criterion-specific exclusions and user-agent-controlled content explicitly. A project waiver is not a standards-conformance pass.

title_ja: 利用者の文字間隔変更に耐えるか試す
requirement_en: Where the language/script uses the relevant spacing properties, apply the criterion user-style changes and check that content and function survive. Test line height 1.5 times font size, paragraph spacing 2 times font size, letter spacing 0.12 times font size and word spacing 0.16 times font size as applicable.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Apply actual user-style overrides to the target and inspect resulting states; these values are resilience tests, not required initial CSS defaults. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not force unused spacing properties into Japanese source or remove text to accommodate the override.

exception_policy.bounds: Only the properties meaningful for the language/script apply; document that scope rather than imposing a universal baseline.

title_ja: 全体の切り取りで情報損失を隠さない
requirement_en: Investigate substantive overflow instead of hiding it behind page-wide clipping. Required text, controls and focus indication must remain accessible in the tested state.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect both relevant CSS and actual overflow/access; a clipping declaration alone does not prove content loss. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Correct the causal width or placement within authorization; never use global clipping as proof of successful reflow.

exception_policy.bounds: Bounded decorative cropping with no informational or interactive loss is outside this prohibition; required content cannot be waived away.

title_ja: 長い表示文字列を実条件で試す
requirement_en: Exercise long labels, URLs and protected names or identifiers at narrow widths and actual enlargement. Full content access and required operation matter more than enforcing a one-line appearance.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect real rendering, focus/activation and complete text access; a usable two-line button is not automatically a failure. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: No universal nowrap or overflow-wrap:anywhere prescription; preserve protected tokens and choose a local treatment.

exception_policy.bounds: A justified local reveal or wrap may be acceptable with complete access; actual project exceptions require scoped approval.

title_ja: 画像内の文字の必要性を区別する
requirement_en: Use real text for information when the available technology can provide its required presentation. Identify criterion-specific customizable or essential presentations rather than converting ordinary text to an image for convenience.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect structure, image purpose and alternatives; logotypes and genuine essential presentations have distinct applicability. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not rasterize body copy to hide layout problems or infer asset rights from the criterion exception.

exception_policy.bounds: Record the applicable essential/customizable exception and its accessible context; an ordinary waiver cannot claim WCAG conformance.

title_ja: 読み込まれた書体と代替表示を確認する
requirement_en: Verify actual font loading, glyph coverage and fallback rendering in the target environment. Record which fonts were observed and which fallback conditions remain untested.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Observe loaded/fallback faces and representative source glyphs; a declared family list is not verification of coverage. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not bundle or download font files without authorization and rights; preserve source characters when glyphs are unavailable.

exception_policy.bounds: Fallback can be deliberate if its actual readability and coverage are checked; missing checks remain explicit limitations.

title_ja: 必要な操作状態を表示して検査する
requirement_en: Review the states the actual interface requires, including focus, errors and relevant loading or disabled states. A single default screenshot cannot establish that the interaction works.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Exercise applicable controls and inspect each required state; static content with no such control must not acquire fictitious UI states. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Modify only authorized real controls; do not invent testimonials, dashboards or interaction results.

exception_policy.bounds: State applicability follows the actual UI; any genuine exception must preserve necessary information and operation with bounded approval.
